entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So he's Nao Minamoto.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: He wants to die because he hurt his sister...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We can't leave him.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: He does look like he's got the resolve of[n]someone who wants to commit suicide.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Be careful, Joker!

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Phantom Thieves... You really came.

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Good... Now I won't be able to hurt my[n]sister ever again.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We're not here to kill you. We're here to[n]change your heart.

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Change of heart? No, I want you guys to kill[n]me...

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Because... Because I...

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: I hate her! I hate my sister for getting in the[n]way of my life!

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: If it weren't for her, I could have gone to[n]high school... and college!

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: I could have hung out with my friends[n]instead of working all the time! Maybe[n]I could have joined a school club!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Think over it harder!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's still a part of you that wants to[n]protect her, even if it means giving up[n]your time, right!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Yes... I shouldn't think these thoughts. It's[n]not true...

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: I... I want her to have a different life than[n]I do... I really want her to be happy...

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: No! I hate her! I hate her guts!!!

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: No! That's not true! Just kill me... I want to[n]die...

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Mom, dad... Why did you leave me like[n]this...

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Why... why won't you listen to me!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: I told you to kill me!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Watch out, Joker! He's attacking!

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: *gasp* *pant*

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are you all right? Have you calmed down?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It must have been hard to tell yourself that[n]you hate your sister.

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: But it's not something I told myself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: I refused to believe that some part of me[n]felt that way about my sister.

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: The more I refused it, the larger that[n]feeling got, until it became monstrous...

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: But now I can accept that part of myself...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Does that mean...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You really did hate your sister?

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Yes. Those are my true feelings.

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: But... It's also true that I love her.

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Both feelings were real.
Do you still want us to kill you?
No more wanting to die.

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: If I die now, my sister will be all alone...[n]I can't let that happen.

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: ...Thank you.

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Even after I told you that I hate my sister,[n]you still tell me that...

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Maybe I sent out that request because those[n]were the words I wanted to hear...

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: I probably can't be with my sister after[n]injuring her but...

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: I'm so glad that I was able to feel that I love[n]my sister again.

entries.speaker: Shadow Minamoto
entries.en: Thank you, Phantom Thieves...
